LocalAdminToken.name: X-TraceMason-Token
LocalAdminToken.description: Trusted-local Host/Origin boundary plus token on all APIs; principal-bound tasks and manifests; ID alone does not authorize. Managed remote client authentication not provided by loopback token.

x-gateway-integration.ordinary_api: all proxy requests inspected before opening upstream; safe automatic outcomes forwarded without requiring UI
x-gateway-integration.needs_review: 409 privacy_review_required + task reference; no upstream request. Client must use managed review protocol; no spoofed success.
x-gateway-integration.file_upload: not implemented vendor upload adapters reject uninspectable upload; external file IDs with no local source cannot be attested
x-gateway-integration.stream: response GET does not trigger or repeat outbound request
